title: Limit the range and step size of the number of print copies
goal: uses min, max and step to define the valid values ​​of numeric controls.
summary: Double page information is distributed in paired copies. At least two servings at a time, and at most twenty servings, and you can only choose an even number.
tasks: Set the minimum value 2, the maximum value 20, and the step size 2 for the number input box #copies.
is reserved as required. Verifications 2 and 20 can pass, but verifications 1, 9, and 22 will be rejected.

example.note: browser starts from min as the step base. This control accepts 5, 10, 15, and 20.

hint: The minimum value and maximum value are both included in the allowable range, and step represents the difference between two adjacent valid values.
